To actually benchmark the perf, you can just benchmark the portion of running the generator after a change; so load the project, run them once, then make a change in the setup, then in the actual benchmark just re-run the generation. If it's doing less work, it should be quicker. Razor has some prior art here: https://github.com/dotnet/razor/tree/main/src/Compiler/perf/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.Microbenchmarks.Generator

The other side of this equation is to actually test that certain parts of the pipeline don't run when you make a change. Unfortunately we don't have any very good docs on how to do that, but it is supported by setting `trackIncrementalSteps` when creating the generator driver, and you can then pull information out of the `RunResult` about which steps actually ran and why.
